briefdescription.para: A tag type used to explicitly indicate the absence of a callback function.

blockquote.para: Passing empty_callback{} is not the same as passing an empty lambda (e.g., []{}). Using this explicit tag type allows internal algorithms to use compile-time checks to completely eliminate the callback invocation branch at compile time. This guarantees strict zero-cost abstractions, vastly improves performance in unoptimized/debug builds, and speeds up compilation times.
